Cuba from 31-33 set-1 down. Aug 26 - Sep 11 2022, Katowice/Gliwice/Ljubljana.

TWO-PHASE FORMAT byte-locked: 4 pools of 6 (60) -> pools E/F of 8 with only cross-pool fixtures played (16+16) and FULL first-round results carried into standings -> QF/SF/3P/F (8). Per-row venue codes decoded (GDA Arnhem/ERA Gdansk/ATA Lodz/AHA Rotterdam/OMA Apeldoorn/GLA Gliwice) incl. the Arnhem three-courts-in-a-stadium opening phase (all 24 teams there to Sep 26, footnote byte-read). TRIPLE FIDELITY LOCK: (1) first-round standings == recomputed pool points for all 24 teams; (2) cumulative second-round standings == full-first-round + phase-2 recomputation for all 16 E/F teams (hand-verified on Serbia 714-570 before assertion); (3) spine QF==top-4s, F==SF winners. Russia removed Mar-2022 (FIVB ineligibility, invasion of Ukraine), Croatia invited. Champions SERBIA - 2nd consecutive title (MVP Boskovic, best setter Drca, libero Pusic) d. Brazil 3-0 in Apeldoorn; Italy bronze 3-0 over USA (Egonu best scorer 275); QF epics Serbia d. co-host Poland 16-14-in-the-5th at Gliwice and Brazil d. Japan 15-13 from 0-2 down. Sep 23 - Oct 15 2022, Netherlands+Poland (first dual-hosted women's WCh).

UPSET EDITION preserved: defending Olympic champs FRANCE OUT IN POOLS (18th; lost 2-3 to Finland AND 2-3 to Argentina), BRAZIL 17th (first pool exit in decades), Japan 23rd, Iran d. Serbia 15-9-in-the-5th R16; host Philippines' 20-22 extended-fifth heartbreaker vs Iran; NEW STORE-RECORD SET: Bulgaria d. Germany 40-38 in set 1 (78 points). Sep 12-28 2025, Metro Manila.
